MRR (Mean Reciprocal Rank) is a statistic measure for evaluating any process that produces a list of possible responses to a sample of queries...

answer_4.quote: We employ crowd workers to evaluate the responses generated by different models, and 1000 samples for each model.
answer_4.guideline: Our evaluation schema scores each sentence according to the following rules: 1. Relevance If a fluent response is logically consistent and relevant to the content of the comment, it will get 1. Otherwise, it will get 0. 2. Informativeness If a response has achieved the requirements of 1 score and is additionally rich in content, it will get 2.
